title: Compact generation is preserved by equivalence
statement: For an additive shift-compatible equivalence e : C ≌ D between triangulated categories with w-indexed coproducts, IsCompactlyGeneratedTriangulated.{w} C implies IsCompactlyGeneratedTriangulated.{w} D.

proof.text: Map a compact generating family along e. Additive Hom equivalences and the coproduct comparison identify each canonical direct-sum map with the corresponding map in C, preserving compactness. The coproduct image is a generator because e reflects zero objects and nonzero morphisms and commutes with shifts.

lean.statement:
theorem compactGenerationEquivalence
    {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₁} C] [Category.{v₂} D]
    [HasZeroObject C] [HasZeroObject D] [HasShift C ℤ] [HasShift D ℤ]
    [Preadditive C] [Preadditive D]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor D n).Additive]
    [Pretriangulated C] [Pretriangulated D] [IsTriangulated C] [IsTriangulated D]
    [HasCoproducts.{w} C] [HasCoproducts.{w} D]
    (e : C ≌ D) [e.functor.Additive] [e.inverse.Additive] [e.functor.CommShift ℤ]
    (hC : IsCompactlyGeneratedTriangulated.{w} C) :
    IsCompactlyGeneratedTriangulated.{w} D
